posts.name: Katrina Kaif
posts.caption: Katrina's team shut down reports of a 2027 acting comeback via OTT, calling the claims 'baseless and misleading.' The actress continues to enjoy motherhood after welcoming son Vihaan with Vicky Kaushal in November 2025.

posts.name: Diljit Dosanjh
posts.caption: Diljit's Main Vaapas Aaunga with Imtiaz Ali releases June 12. He and AR Rahman dropped a soulful refugee-tribute video 'Kya Kamaal Hai' as the AURA Tour 2026 continues to sell out arenas worldwide.

posts.name: Alia Bhatt
posts.caption: The Alpha teaser dropped on June 10, giving fans their first look at Alia as an elite spy in the YRF Spy Universe. The female-led action thriller with Sharvari hits theatres July 3.

posts.name: Priyanka Chopra
posts.caption: Priyanka ranks #3 on Fortune India's Most Valuable Celebrities 2026 and is the only woman to grace a standalone cover. Her global brand power continues to soar with Bvlgari and Bentley partnerships.

posts.name: Shah Rukh Khan
posts.caption: SRK holds the #2 spot on Fortune India's Most Valuable Celebrities 2026. His action-thriller King with Deepika, Suhana Khan and Abhishek Bachchan is locked for a Christmas 2026 release.

posts.name: Kareena Kapoor Khan
posts.caption: Kareena spoke out against female objectification in the Peddi row, defending sensuality with elegance. She's reportedly in advanced talks to reunite with Salman Khan in Raj & DK's superhero film.

posts.name: Shraddha Kapoor
posts.caption: Shraddha's biographical drama Eetha is locked for an August 28 Raksha Bandhan release. She plays legendary Tamasha artist Vithabai Narayangaonkar in what promises to be her most powerful performance yet.

posts.name: Deepika Padukone
posts.caption: Deepika is set to star in Allu Arjun and Atlee's Raka, reportedly using a body double for action sequences. She also features in SRK's King releasing this Christmas, marking their reunion after years.

posts.name: Ranveer Singh
posts.caption: Ranveer takes legal action against FWICE over the Don 3 non-cooperation ban, approaching Bombay Civil Court. He ranks #5 on Fortune India's Most Valuable Celebrities and begins shooting Pralay in August.

posts.name: Aishwarya Rai Bachchan
posts.caption: Kangana Ranaut rallied to Aishwarya's defense amid Cannes criticism, saying 'she is not here to please you.' The former Miss World continues to command global attention on the fashion circuit.

posts.name: Rashmika Mandanna
posts.caption: Rashmika's Cocktail 2 with Shahid Kapoor tops IMDb's most-anticipated Indian film list ahead of its June 19 release. She's also reportedly in talks to portray legendary singer MS Subbulakshmi in a biopic.

posts.name: Samantha Ruth Prabhu
posts.caption: Samantha's Ma Inti Bangaram hits theatres June 19, featuring her in a double-life role with action sequences. Her third collaboration with director Nandini Reddy is building strong pre-release buzz.

posts.name: Allu Arjun
posts.caption: Allu Arjun's next film with hitmaker Atlee (AA22) has officially gone on floors. He also ranks #10 on Fortune India's Most Valuable Celebrities 2026, cementing his pan-India dominance post-Pushpa 2.

posts.name: Ram Charan
posts.caption: Ram Charan's Peddi crosses ₹260 crore worldwide in its first week, emerging as his highest-grossing solo film ever. The sports drama with Janhvi Kapoor continues its strong theatrical run.

posts.name: Jr NTR
posts.caption: War 2 with Hrithik Roshan wrapped its theatrical run with ₹236 Cr net despite a massive ₹191 Cr opening weekend. Focus now shifts to NTR's upcoming projects as the YRF Spy Universe regroups.

posts.name: Janhvi Kapoor
posts.caption: Janhvi stars opposite Ram Charan in the blockbuster Peddi, now past ₹260 Cr worldwide. Her portrayal has sparked intense debate about female representation in Indian cinema.

posts.name: Ananya Panday
posts.caption: Ananya continues to expand her brand presence and has been spotted at high-profile events as she gears up for her next film projects in the coming months.

posts.name: Kiara Advani
posts.caption: Kiara features in the YRF Spy Universe alongside Hrithik Roshan and Jr NTR in War 2. The actress is also eyeing her next big project after a packed 2026 lineup.

posts.name: Hrithik Roshan
posts.caption: War 2's theatrical run wrapped with mixed results despite a massive opening. All eyes are now on Alpha's July 3 release to revive the YRF Spy Universe that Hrithik helped build.

posts.name: Varun Dhawan
posts.caption: Varun's Hai Jawani Toh Ishq Hona Hai with David Dhawan is in theatres now. He had fans in splits after Tanmay Bhat's viral jab suggesting he's the 'professional, reliable' actor Farhan Akhtar needs for Don 3.

posts.name: Shreya Ghoshal
posts.caption: Shreya continues her acclaimed concert tour across major US cities in 2026, bringing Bollywood's most iconic melodies to sold-out venues from coast to coast.

posts.name: AR Rahman
posts.caption: AR Rahman composes the music for Imtiaz Ali's Main Vaapas Aaunga, collaborating with Diljit Dosanjh on the soulful 'Kya Kamaal Hai' — a tribute to refugees displaced by war and conflict.

posts.name: Vijay Thalapathy
posts.caption: Vijay's political party TVK won 108 seats in the Tamil Nadu elections, making a blockbuster debut in politics. His final film Jana Nayagan is now poised for release amid unprecedented hype.
